articles.title: RAIDERS vs. BILLS (NFL WEEK 6)
articles.author: Troy Torrence
articles.summary: RAIDERS vs. BILLS (NFL WEEK 6) I find this game to be fascinating, particularly because I faded the Raiders with a max bet in week 5. As I started handicapping this game, I quickly realized that all the reasons I was buying the Patriots are not present this week. In fact it's the exact opposite. Patriots Defense = Elite vs. Play-Action Bills Defense = Terrible vs. Play-Action (Kirk Cousins Elite via play-action) Patriots Defense = Single High/Middle Closed Bills Defense = 2 high/Middle Open (Kirk Cousins attacking in between the numbers) Situionally, does it get any better? Bills off OT win on the west coast. Raiders off back-to-back losses, back at home, indoors on a fast track. And don't even get me started on this market environment..... Which is about as Bullish as it gets.
